item.title: Galaxy's Edge Turns Five
item.description: The Star Wars land Galaxy's Edge just marked its fifth anniversary. In this episode we walk through how the land has changed since opening day. The Rise of the Resistance ride remains the headline attraction, and its reliability has improved dramatically over the years. We also cover the new seasonal offerings at Oga's Cantina and whether the blue milk is still worth the price. Fans continue to debate whether a second Star Wars land is on the horizon for the resort. Finally, we share listener stories about proposing at the top of the Millennium Falcon queue.

item.title: Marvel Day at Sea Returns
item.description: Marvel Day at Sea is back on the cruise line for another season. The deck party featuring Spider-Man and the Avengers has been expanded with new pyrotechnics. Character meet-and-greets now include several heroes that were previously exclusive to the theme parks. We break down which sailings still have availability and how prices compare to last year. Our verdict: for Marvel fans, this remains the single best value on the water.
